## R options

Set rqti options with `options()`. Put the same calls in `.Rprofile` to apply
them in future R sessions.

### Maxima executable

If Maxima is not on PATH, set the full path to its executable or launcher:

```{r maxima-path}
options(rqti.maxima = "/usr/bin/maxima")
# Windows example: use your installation's actual path
options(rqti.maxima = "C:/maxima-5.44.0/bin/maxima.bat")
```

See [Maxima exercises](maxima.html) for authoring and preview instructions.

### Exercise display names

`rqti.task_names` controls exercise names in previews, XML/ZIP exports, and LMS
uploads. Choose one of these values:

| Value | Display name |
|:------|:-------------|
| `"title"` (default) | Exercise title; source filename if the title is missing |
| `"filename"` | Source filename without its extension |
| `"both"` | `Title (filename)` |
| `"hidden"` | Generic labels such as `Task 1.1` |

```{r task-names}
options(rqti.task_names = "hidden")
```

A function's `task_names` argument overrides the option for that call:

```{r override}
rqti::rmd2zip("exercise.Rmd", task_names = "both")
```

Display names do not change identifiers or exported filenames. See
`help("task_names", package = "rqti")` for details.

Set `rqti.maxima` and `rqti.task_names` in the RStudio console; subsequent Knit
calls read these settings from the running preview server without a restart.

## Environment variables

Environment variables use `Sys.setenv()` instead of `options()`. For example,
select an OPAL instance with:

```{r opal-endpoint}
Sys.setenv(RQTI_API_ENDPOINT = "https://bildungsportal.sachsen.de/opal/")
```

For persistence, put `RQTI_API_ENDPOINT=https://bildungsportal.sachsen.de/opal/`
in `.Renviron`. See [Workflow with the OPAL API](api_opal.html) for details.
Preview connection variables are managed by rqti automatically.
